banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Lose management connectivity; separate control-plane availability from data-plane service.
preconditions: JavaScript enabled; standalone file browser lesson
Established blue-v1 route at synthetic epoch 7
Independent shared training harness remains available
Three fixed established-user journeys with a 100 synthetic millisecond budget
actions: Choose fixed route condition and recovery evidence
Lose only per-run management and observe rejected synthetic command
Sample established data journeys during the outage
Report the scoped fault via independent harness
Observe confirmed or missing recovery acknowledgement
Predict PASS, FAIL or UNKNOWN; check and retain
New attempt retains checked history; explicit reset clears local data
syntheticFixture: fixtures.js: independent, controller-dependent, service-error, missing-sample; recovery confirmed or missing
assertions: Loss of per-run management never changes the established route or epoch
Independent established samples can succeed while management is unavailable
Per-request controller dependency and service errors remain failures after recovery
Missing observations remain unknown and are not zero-latency successes
Independent harness reports exact fault scope and measured samples during control loss
Only confirmed recovery evidence restores control; missing acknowledgement is unknown
Control availability, data service, recovery, verification and prediction correctness are separate
Attempted equals success plus failure plus unknown, including retained negative attempts
Strict input/arity/phase guards precede mutation; snapshots are deep-frozen
No history eviction; reset is explicit and keyboard operable
history: Memory-only full checked attempts; no eviction. New attempt retains; explicit reset or reload clears all data. Active and retained metric rows must not be added.
stateGuards: idle -> prepared -> outage -> sampled -> reported -> recovered/recovery-unknown -> checked; exact plain enum record and ordered single actions
limits: All connectivity, commands, routes, samples and recovery are synthetic trace data, not actual operations
No actual network, management connectivity, control outage, data-plane service or harness recovery certification
Established-user samples do not establish migrated-user success
B-S089 and D-S089 remain incomplete; no native Azure or five-nines result
Node22 is test tooling only; no production Node24 validation
Published browser helper has a known lifecycle limitation; individual bounded browser evidence is not unattended-runner qualification
No cloud, IaC, scaffold, identity, credentials, deploy, spend, packages, frameworks, downloads, unsafe flags or foreground leases
acceptance: Parent-owned empirical acceptance pending. One frozen S unit; tests, plumbing and refinement earn no additional credit.
